title: habenaria plantaginea var. nepalensis
intro: Habenaria plantaginea var. nepalensis, commonly known as the Himalayan yellow ground orchid, is a species of orchid native to the Himalayan region. This plant is used in traditional medicine, and research has shown its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of H. plantaginea var. nepalensis include wound healing, pain relief, and treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, although further research is needed to fully understand its therapeutic potential.
